title: A Balance of Iron and Salt

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A Balance of Iron and Salt examines the hidden cost of rescue.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its future survives through systems that also shape human choices.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Families receive protection while surrendering decisions they may want back.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This science fiction novel makes that bargain personal, civic, and physical.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A dying man receives a continuity shell before his life ends.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Offshore, a floating city brings competing promises of freedom.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks whose freedom another person's safety can legitimately consume.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The opening brings an extraordinary delivery into an ordinary family house.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jonah works at a forge beside a changing Atlantic coast.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The imperfect sound of a cart matters to his attention.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Kazi remains alive when the shell intended for continuity arrives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That timing makes technological survival awkward before it becomes philosophical.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Different family members bring different obligations to the same delivered body.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The novel lets disagreement emerge through affection, work, and bodily frailty.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Port Nacre faces Asterion across a shared stretch of water.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: One city's arrival changes trade, movement, and expectations almost immediately.
